message: ExamReady SA v1.2.6 adds clearer tutor explanations, interactive source-grounded quizzes and illustrated flashcards to optional Study tools. Study tools need internet and upload selected PDF, DOCX or TXT notes to the staging AI service; Cloudflare receives only a short illustration prompt. Avoid sensitive documents. Offline exam practice and progress remain available. Install over signed v1.2.2–v1.2.5 to preserve progress. Updates remain optional.
